verdict.rationale: The pack lists Datadog's Dashboards, Monitors and API Reference pages by title only. No item states that dashboards or monitors can be defined as JSON, Terraform or API calls and provisioned repeatably. Treating a separate API reference page as proof of dashboards-as-code would be inference, not documented evidence, so this applicable axis gets none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define dashboards and alerts as code (JSON models, Terraform, or API) and provision them repeatably
